notes: Querer changes its stem to quier- in the present tense (quiero, quieres, quiere).
When followed by a person, querer means to love or care deeply for someone, whereas desear is rarely used for people in everyday speech.

senses.definition: To have the desire or wish to do or have something.

examples.text: Quiero comprar un coche nuevo este año.
examples.translation: I want to buy a new car this year.
examples.emotion: focused and determined, planning for the future

senses.definition: To feel deep affection or love for someone.

examples.translation: I love my parents very much.
examples.emotion: warm and sincere, speaking with genuine affection

definitions: To have the desire or wish to do or have something.
